title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: Sightsavers Irelands' climate action project in Liberia is implemented in Bong and Nimba counties (North-western region), and Grand Gedeh, River Gee, Maryland, Grand Kru, and Sinoe counties (South-eastern region). The programme partners with faith-based organisations in the Northwestern region and government facilities in the Southeastern region. The objective is to enhance resilience to flooding by integrating adaptive climate change actions into the government's existing regulatory and policy frameworks. Key activities include installing renewable energy systems in two eye health facilities in the Northwest and Southeast regions, developing and disseminating climate and environmental sustainability awareness materials for eye health beneficiaries, including people with disabilities. Adaptation: - Climate change adaptation is a significant motivation for the project. The project aims to increase the Liberian governments adaptation to the impact and risk of flooding through strengthening waste management guidelines, assessing the vulnerability of eye health facilities using an environmental sustainability toolkit. -Advocacy with ministries to strengthen existing regulatory and policy framework to include environmental considerations will promote positive impacts on the local and regional communities. Mitigation: - The development of green vision initiatives will reduce GHGs through renewable energy sources and reduction of paper waste via the EMR system.
